full_prompt_en: The image is a vertical devotional-style painting shown within the selected square crop, bordered on all sides by a narrow patterned gold frame. A huge tree dominates the center. Its golden trunk rises from a white terraced building, and its densely dotted dark green canopy spreads almost the width of the painted panel. A round golden sun sits just above the top of the tree, framed by rows of pink-white clouds. Behind the building, pale mountains make a low repeating horizon beneath a peach sky. The white estate has arches, balconies, and a central doorway, all rendered as small careful shapes. In the lower foreground, blue streams divide patches of ocher and green land. White cattle graze or stand beside the water, with small flowers, shrubs, and stones filling the intervening spaces. The scale is symbolic rather than strictly realistic: the tree is far larger than the architecture and animals, while the many details remain clear in a compressed picture space. Fine dotted foliage, outlined water edges, and minute architectural marks create a patient ornamental surface. Warm gold, peach, pink, and cream are balanced by dark green tree masses and muted blue water. Light seems even and decorative; the golden sun provides a central emblem rather than casting naturalistic shadows. The composition is vertically ordered from water and animals at the bottom, to white buildings, to the great trunk and canopy, then to sun and clouds. It feels serene, abundant, and ceremonially arranged. The painted frame reinforces the sense of a complete miniature world, rich in small forms but organized around one unmistakable central tree.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅竖向的礼仪式细密画，在选取的方形图格中显示，四边有窄金色图案框。一棵巨树主导中央。金色树干从白色层叠建筑中升起，点点深绿色密树冠几乎横跨整块画面。一轮金日正位于树顶上方，被成排粉白云围住。楼后，浅山在桃色天空下形成低而重复的地平线。白色宅院有拱、阳台和中央门口，均以细小谨慎形状绘出。下方前景，蓝色溪水分隔赭与绿土地。白牛在水边吃草或站立，小花、灌木与石块填满间隙。尺度具有象征性而非严格写实：树比建筑和动物大得多，众多细节在压缩空间里仍清楚。细点叶、描边水岸和微小建筑标记形成耐心的装饰表面。暖金、桃、粉和奶油色与深绿树冠及暗蓝水流平衡。光均匀且装饰性；金日是中央标志，而非投下写实阴影。构图从底部水与动物、白建筑、大树干和树冠到顶端日与云，依次竖向组织。画面安宁、丰盛且带仪式安排。画框进一步强调完整微型世界：小形状丰富，却围绕无可误认的中央大树。
style_prompt_en: Highly detailed miniature painting arranges many small natural and built forms around one dominant central silhouette. Fine dots, precise outlines, patterned borders, and repeated tiny motifs create an ornamental surface. Warm gold, peach, pink, cream, deep green, and muted blue are balanced in compact areas. Space is compressed and vertically ordered rather than governed by strict photographic perspective. Light is even and emblematic, with a radiant disk or pale area functioning as a compositional crown. Repeated foliage marks, architectural arches, water curves, and scattered small accents reward close viewing. The overall effect is serene, ceremonial, and abundant, with a framed pictorial world held together by clear hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 高细节细密画把许多小型自然与建筑形态围绕一个主导中央剪影安排。细点、准确描边、图案边框与重复小符号形成装饰表面。暖金、桃、粉、奶油、深绿与暗蓝在紧凑区域中平衡。空间被压缩并竖向排序，而非遵从严格摄影透视。光均匀而象征化，发亮圆盘或浅色区担当构图冠顶。重复叶点、建筑拱、水的曲线与散布小重点值得近看。整体安宁、仪式化且丰盛，由清晰层级把带框的图像世界维系在一起。
theme_en: A monumental tree above a white estate, streams, and grazing cattle
theme_zh: 一棵巨树覆盖白色宅院、溪流与吃草的牛
name: Pichwai painting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
